도시의 공공 도서관은 단순히 책을 빌려 주는 곳에서 지역 주민이 함께 배우고 교류하는 공간으로 변하고 있다. 최근 많은 도서관이 디지털 자료실과 메이커 공간을 마련해 3D 프린터나 영상 편집 장비를 누구나 사용할 수 있게 했다. 어린이를 위한 독서 교실과 어르신을 위한 스마트폰 강좌도 꾸준히 열리고 있다. 도서관 관계자들은 이용자의 연령과 관심사가 다양해진 만큼 프로그램도 더 세분화해야 한다고 말한다.

한편 예산과 인력의 한계 때문에 모든 도서관이 이런 변화를 따라가기는 쉽지 않다. 작은 분관은 여전히 사서 한두 명이 대출과 반납, 행사 준비를 모두 맡는 경우가 많다. 전문가들은 지역 대학이나 시민 단체와 협력해 프로그램을 공동으로 운영하면 부담을 줄일 수 있다고 조언한다. 도서관이 주민의 일상 가까이에 있는 공공 공간이라는 점을 생각하면, 이러한 협력 모델은 앞으로 더 중요해질 것으로 보인다.

, Kadirojo I, Purwomartani, Kalasan, Kabupaten Sleman, Daerah Istimewa Yogyakarta 55571. Atau di Jalan UKRIM (Universitas Kristen Immanuel).

Jarak dari Malioboro dengan Jogja Airport kurang lebih 13 kilometer. Atau bisa ditempuh dengan waktu 30 menit perjalanan melalui jalan Laksda Adisucipto - Jalan Raya Jogja - Solo.
Jika dari Malioboro ambil arah ke jalan Mataram, dilanjut ke Jalan Abu Bakar Ali menuju Stadion Kridosono. Dari Stadion Kridosono selanjutnya menuju jalan Trimo - Jalan Langensari - Jalan Munggur - Perempatan Gejayan - Jalan Laksda Adisucipto lurus sampai di Pertigaan Fly over Janti.
Dari Jembatan Janti masih lurus ke arah Solo, hingga sampai di pertigaan Maguwoharjo dan Pertigaan Bandara Adisucipto.
Dari pertigaan Trafic Light Bandara Adisucipto masih lurus ke arah Solo kurang lebih 1.5 kilometer. Patokannya setelah dari pertigaan Bandara Adisucipto, di sebelah kanan ada percetakan koran Kedaulatan Rakyat dan Hotel Srikandi. Di sebelah kiri jalan akan ada jalan masuk ke BULOG DIY dan ke kampus Universitas Kristen Immanuel (UKRIM). Ikutin jalan UKRIM tersebut sampai di Selokan Mataram. Lokasinya sebelum perempatan Selokan Mataram disebelah kanan jalan jika kita dari jalan Solo. Jarak antara Jogja Airport Resto dari Jalan Raya Jogja - Solo kurang lebih 1.5 kilometer.
Fasilitas di Jogja Airport Resto
Pembangunan Jogja Airport resto hampir selesai, kurang lebih sudah mencapai 90%.
Menurut penuturan pemilik Jogja Airport Resto Pak Andy yang juga selaku pemilik Jogja Airflight, salah satu sekolah pramugari di kota Jogja menyampaikan, "Nantinya selain Resto, akan ada juga Mini Museum angkut seperti yang ada di Batu, Malang".
Selain restoran, nanti juga akan ada mini museum angkut yang memperlihatkan koleksi kendaraan motor dan mobil klasik. Rencananya mini museum angkut tersebut ditargetkan selesai di tahun depan di bulan Maret 2019.
Fasilitas yang ada di Restoran ini ada Cafe (Lounge bandara), cafe outdor dan indor, Restoran pesawat berjumlah 2 unit, toilet, mushala, area bermain anak dan area parkir yang luas.
Selain fasilitas diatas, nanti juga akan ada fasilitas simulasi untuk belajar menerbangkan pesawat.

YoungAi

A personal AI assistant that lives on your own machine.
Hold to talk. It remembers what you tell it, browses the web, writes Word/PDF/PowerPoint/Excel files, makes videos, keeps following up on a job, and hands the result to the next app on your phone. Model, memory and files all stay on the box.

Website · user guide · English · 中文 · Hugging Face · Technical notes

![YoungAi Studio: the assistant hunting for the cheapest DGX Spark](docs/img/studio-agent-en.png) The model behind it is DeepSeek V4.1 Flash, the 1017 release (510 GB as published), shrunk to 113.6 GB and running on one 128 GB machine, a DGX Spark or an Apple Silicon Mac, with a 1M-token context. Open source, MIT. Plain C99 + CUDA on the Spark, Metal on the Mac, one Makefile, no third-party libraries linked. ## The model | | | |---|---| | Size | 510 GB as released → 113.6 GB base (8 weights vector-quantized together, ~1.6 bit/weight, no training data used) | | Context | 1M tokens; the full KV cache is 0.89 GB | | Domain sidecars | finance / code / law / medicine / science, ~40 MB each, switched from the chat box in under a second | With a sidecar, how often our next token matches the original full-precision model's goes up 2.6–3.8 points (code: 78.3% → 82.0%), and general English text goes up too (76.8% → 77.9–79.7%). Method and full tables: [technical notes §5](docs/TECHNICAL.md#5-results). ### Speed | | DGX Spark (GB10, 128 GB) | Mac Studio M5 Max (128 GB) | |---|---:|---:| | Reading the prompt | 1,040–1,070 tokens/s (9.2k-token prompt) | 627 tokens/s (25.5k-token prompt) | | Writing, speculative decoding (default) | 48.2 tokens/s | 35–36 tokens/s prose, 41–42 code | | Writing, plain decoding | 29.9 tokens/s | not measured | | Measured by | us | a contributor ([#3](https://github.com/fodelf/YoungAi/pull/3)) | Both columns use the same 113.6 GB base, temperature 0 and 512 written tokens. The Spark numbers come from a real request that was never used for tuning, with the coding sidecar on. The Mac numbers come through `ds4-server`, best of two runs. The prompts differ, so compare the columns roughly rather than digit by digit. More workloads and context lengths: [technical notes §5.2](docs/TECHNICAL.md#52-speed). **On a Mac**, `make` builds the Metal version and 133 GPU kernel tests pass on a real Apple GPU. Our own Mac has 16 GB, so the full-model numbers above are the contributor's. ## What it does **A request comes in, the assistant does the work in a sandbox, then hands the result on.** The screenshot above is a real run: "find me the cheapest DGX Spark on the web" took 16 minutes, 12 rounds and 43 tool calls, all on the machine itself. | You say | It does | You get | |---|---|---| | "Anything good to eat nearby?"
